desc:
👮‍♂️🔒 You've been thrown into the toughest prison in the whole world — nobody ever escapes! Your best buddy already tried to break out and totally failed. Now he's just sitting there, all sad and gloomy.

💪🔓 But not you! You've got a plan. You're gonna skip rope every single day — jump, jump, jump! — until your legs are super strong. Then, with one MIGHTY leap, you'll bounce right over the giant prison wall… and land in the free world!
